hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) cd backend 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; uv run ruff check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.css) cd frontend 2>/dev/null && npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in frontend/src/components/*|frontend/src/pages/*) if grep -qE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Design spec: hex literal found in a component. Use a token from docs/design-spec.md.' >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */data/raw/*) echo 'Raw upstream data is immutable. See docs/data-pipeline.md.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
